title: Quaint Ethiopian Collard Greens Gomen
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring collard greens, saeujeot shrimp paste, and a unique spherification process, making it a cozy and diabetic-friendly option. This recipe is a twist on the classic gomen, with a focus on grassy and bouncy textures.
instructions: Rinse the collard greens and remove the stems, then chop them into small pieces.
In a blender or food processor, combine the saeujeot shrimp paste, onion, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat, then add the blended paste and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped collard greens to the pot, along with the salt and black pepper, and cook until the greens are tender.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with a small amount of water to create a solution.
Using a syringe or spoon, drop small amounts of the collard green mixture into the alginate solution, creating small spheres.
Let the spheres sit in the alginate solution for 10-15 minutes to set.
Remove the spheres from the alginate solution and rinse them with water.
Serve the gomen spheres hot, garnished with additional collard greens if desired.
